title: Unset master token bypasses nonzero device ACL authorization
summary: indigo_change_property accepts omitted request token 0 as the default master token 0, bypassing nonzero device ACL. Confirmed by native XML/JSON regression and unauthorized Server module loading. Next: require nonzero master before master-token equality authorizes. Owner explicitly limited this task to tests and documented findings; coordinator must obtain separate repair authorization.
evidence: security.md; local execution logs referenced there

resolution.evidence: Documented contract: indigo_docs/INDIGO_DEVICE_ACCESS_CONTROL_AND_LOCKING.md (Protected Devices and Master Tokens). An unset server master token disables device protection; accepting a tokenless request is expected. Owner explicitly requested preserving this behavior and closing this false positive on 2026-11-05. See task 20261105141337-ccae-close-acl-false-positive/verification.md.
